properties.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 15 at 9:43PM EDT until October 16 at 11:00AM EDT by NWS Northern Indiana
properties.description:
* WHAT...For the Small Craft Advisory, west winds 20 to 30 knots
with gusts up to 33 knots and waves 5 to 9 feet expected. For
the Gale Warning, north winds 25 to 35 knots with gusts up to 45
knots and waves 12 to 18 feet expected.

* WHERE...Michigan City IN to St Joseph MI.

* WHEN...For the Small Craft Advisory, until 11 AM EDT Friday.
For the Gale Warning, from 11 AM Friday to 2 AM EDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous waves which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
properties.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for hazardous conditions.

NWSheadline: SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 11 AM EDT FRIDAY... ...GALE WARNING REMAINS IN EFFECT FROM 11 AM FRIDAY TO 2 AM EDT SATURDAY
